dedupe_keys.name: an errata corrected plant level dataset of solar wind and hydropower curtailment in chile s national electricity system 2022 2026

description: An errata-corrected, plant-level dataset of solar, wind and hydropower curtailment in Chile's National Electricity System (2022–2026), published by Reyes Cerda, Pablo; Cea Morales, Kerven, consolidates Chilean operator curtailment reports into plant-level daily and hourly tables. Coverage: 300 Chilean generation plants, 1 January 2022 to 31 May 2026; hydropower daily records begin June 2024 and hourly detail July 2024. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Twelve hydropower plants switch category in operator reports. The registry resolves them to 300 plants, whereas raw plant-technology pairs total 312; this distinction must be retained. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
